## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: release — docs/design/release/release.md; system — docs/design/system/system.md; design — docs/design/design/design.md; published-skill-first-release-amendment — specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md. Exact current subjects and contextual basis are stored with this judgment.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r4, approved/current and unchanged.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r4, round 4.
- Material findings: no new findings; design-r3-f1 resolved by its original reporter. Earlier design-r1-f1/f2 remain resolved with their historical scope preserved.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: Route may hand this exact approved package to authorized Delivery planning; no activity/work transition is made by this review.
- Claim limitations: approved Design intent and feasibility, not implemented orchestration, configured remote protection, publication, source retirement, Verify or PR readiness.

## Independent correction assessment

The corrected Release contract now supplies a non-circular, explicit dependency chain. C is the sealed source basis; adapter archives are built and validated from it. Their actual facts generate package-bundled adapter metadata and its releases-index digest in an isolated declared overlay. Npm packing follows that generation, and content/index/packed-install checks observe the exact resulting tarball and selected archives. Only then is outer candidate/approval evidence generated with final tarball identity. Outer observations are not inserted back into the tarball. The overlay is derived from C and actual archive bytes, has an allowlisted diff and generator/configuration identity, and participates in approval binding separately from C.

This directly resolves design-r3-f1 against the actual loadVerifiedBundledMetadata consumer and _prepare_local_cli_release_candidate dependency inspected in r3: a valid external archive report cannot substitute for the required trusted metadata bytes inside the package. The Composition/path scenario now rejects a wrong bundled digest despite valid outer archive evidence. Material overlay, metadata/index or tarball changes require a rebuilt/rechecked candidate and new approval; publication uses retained outputs without regeneration after approval. No manual hash work, self-referential source/package identity or new Distribution model is introduced.

The advisory traceability issue is also addressed: full-path, candidate/observation and retry scenarios now cite applicable REL-SR-22–24. These references improve allocation without inventing additional behavior or a new proof ledger.

## Complete-package judgment

Current exact inspection confirms only Release changed among the eighteen r3 engineering/governing/contextual subjects. The complete amended-package assessment in r3 remains substantively applicable to unchanged content: the one-approval objective, explicit reviewed next-version input policy, narrower routine-automation population, deterministic S/C derivation, protected executor and exact artifact/destination binding, separate evidence ref, duration diagnostics and actual safety/evidence boundaries are coherent. The present correction reconciles the outstanding producer/consumer ordering and does not alter proposal scope or another model's responsibilities.

CLI/CI supplies normal preparation, necessary checks, publication, public observation and durable reporting. Setup and genuine missing-version/authority/recovery decisions are explicit exceptions rather than routine human assembly. One protected execution boundary supports the selected human approval, while exact artifact verification remains a repository responsibility. Remote environment setup, OIDC permissions, evidence-ref writes and artifact retention remain concrete deployment dependencies to implement and verify; availability of a provider mechanism is not evidence of current remote setup.

Timing's nonblocking duration consequence is an explicitly selected new-path policy; actual identities, check outcomes and public-event facts remain required. The narrow routine-automation boundary remains precise. Original reviews retain their old subjects and meanings; this approval does not silently reinstate earlier mandatory duration-presence policy or retarget historical source judgments.

System's complete-path composition, Design's bounded DES-SR-21 retention extension and the mixed source's new-profile-only R7/R8 amendment remain consistent. Six exact prose-source removals and the scoped architecture dispositions still require coordinated implementation and actual consumer reconciliation. Historical records, literal baseline, schemas/fixtures and mixed version-specific remainders keep their existing necessary roles. The build correction adds no deletion target or operational bypass.

Representative integrated proof covers the actual coordinator under one substituted approval, with real required validators around safe external substitutes; prerequisite rejection, changed candidate, bundled-metadata failure, duplicate/uncertain or partial publication, public-smoke failure, unavailable timing and evidence-persistence failure remain meaningful boundaries. Separate helper passes do not prove the complete path. Independent final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain necessary for adoption; a live public release is not implementation proof for this change.

## Independence, applicability and checks

The original reporter remains a separate nonauthor reviewer. Parent authored the correction; this reviewer edited no engineering, proposal, activity or work. The r3 judgment and subjects remain original/stale. Finding origin and required outcome remain unchanged, with this explicit reporter-owned resolution supported by the current author evidence and independently inspected model/consumer relationship. Current Proposal Review r4 and other member identities are unchanged and have no changed relevant direction or interface that defeats reliance.

Commands actually used: current primary context, exact subject inspect for all eighteen stored basis subjects, Git diff and bounded corrected-model/source reads; targeted batch. The earlier official GitHub provider documentation check remains applicable to this unchanged mechanism; no new external capability claim was introduced. The author evidence release-design-build-order-r4 records focused model/prose/readability checks and their limits. No runtime, package build, live smoke or publication command was executed by this review. Record-store validation and git diff --check follow the save; they establish persistence/hygiene, not semantic adequacy. No project-map or whole-repository conformance claim is used.
independence_basis: Original independent reporter inspected author-owned correction and complete package relationships without editing any engineering. Parent remains package author; reviewer writes judgment/finding resolution only.
